activity_statements.statement: administers government health and human services programs including Medicaid eligibility and enrollment, SNAP eligibility determination, and clinical assessments for federal, state, and local agencies
operates omnichannel contact centers (web, phone, email, text, live agents) as the citizen-facing service delivery layer for government benefit programs
provides conflict-free clinical assessments and care planning for Medicaid home and community-based services, ensuring individuals receive appropriate care settings
delivers IT modernization and digital transformation services for federal health agencies including CMS and VA, using advanced architectures and AI to improve program performance
supports defense and national security agencies through mission-focused technology and operations services
provides program management consulting to help government agencies transform policy goals into service delivery outcomes, including backlog management and operational optimization
manages Medicaid enterprise system operations for state Medicaid agencies, improving member and provider engagement through technology and process integration

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Government Administration' implies Maximus is a government entity; it is a for-profit government services contractor. Its operational core is running the intake, enrollment, and case-management processes that citizens use to access Medicaid, SNAP, and other public programs — effectively outsourced government bureaucracy.
extraction_notes: maximus.com/about-maximus returned 404; homepage provided rich operational content. Segment revenue weights (Federal vs US Services) are directional estimates from Maximus's publicly known segment structure.
